digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service startup/auth lifecycle
propositions: Long-running MCP and review-bot processes re-read static Gerrit/GitHub/LLM/telemetry config on every operation, allowing config mutation to affect in-progress work and violate startup binding immutability

MCP and review-bot must bind non-secret startup policy and provider capabilities once at service initialization and compose a fresh per-operation snapshot for each request while keeping inbound bearer tokens request-scoped
Inbound OAuth/bearer tokens must never appear in startup/operation snapshots, serialization, logs, caches, or child process environments
Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth (Gerrit token, GitHub token, LLM config) before accepting work and must not fall back to alternate principals when auth is missing or revoked
Static binding mutations (env/file changes) must not rebind running processes; only a restarted/redeployed process observes new material, while SDK-native refreshable capabilities remain SDK-owned
Partial or rejected telemetry provider credentials (Langfuse, OTLP) must disable telemetry observability without changing operation result, while security-critical auth remains fail-closed
